transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?
I guess… I just can’t seem to settle down anymore. It feels like I’m restless inside my own skin, like I need to get up and do the next thing, even when I’m worn out and should be sitting still.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things, even when there isn’t much reason to worry?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say worry is the main thing. I mean, I think about things, but not always in that way. Hard to say.
Have you been feeling tired or have you noticed a loss of energy almost every day, even when you haven’t been doing much?
Not really… I mean, I get worn out sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it being every day or anything like that. Hard to say.
Do you have trouble relaxing, or do you find yourself fidgeting, pacing, or feeling physically restless a lot of the time?
Yes… I do. It’s like I can’t quite settle in my own skin. Even when I’m tired and should be sitting still, I feel like I need to get up and do the next thing.
Do you often feel anxious or find yourself caught up in worries, even about things that might not seem like a big deal?
I’m not sure I’d call it anxious. I do get caught up in things sometimes, but… I don’t know if it’s worry exactly.
Do you find yourself getting irritable or easily agitated, even over small things that wouldn’t usually bother you?
I don’t know… I suppose I can get a little short sometimes, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether it’s over small things.
Have you felt down, sad, or uninterested in things you usually enjoy, almost every day?
I… I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed feeling sad like that every day. Maybe some days I’m just tired of things, but I’m not sure it’s that.
Have you ever experienced sudden episodes where you felt intense fear or discomfort, maybe with symptoms like a racing heart, sweating, or feeling like you couldn’t breathe?
I don’t think so… not like that. I mean, I’ve had moments where I felt uncomfortable, but I haven’t noticed anything with my heart racing or not being able to breathe.
Do you find yourself thinking about things over and over, even when there’s not much you can do about them?

I don’t know if I’d call it thinking things over… it’s more that I get pulled off what I’m doing. Like if I’m trying to sort bills at the kitchen table, the phone lights up or I hear a car door outside, and then I’m just… off track. Even a thought about the garden can do it.
Do you find it hard to get started on tasks, or do you often leave things unfinished once you’ve started?

Yes… I do. If someone gives me, say, three or four things to do for the quilting charity, I might start the first one right away. But then I end up doing some other chore, and… the last parts just don’t get finished.
Do you often have trouble organizing tasks or activities, even when you know what needs to be done?
I’m not sure… I mean, I know what I need to do, usually. But organizing it all… I guess I don’t really think of it that way. It just feels like things don’t come together very neatly.
Do you often lose track of time or find yourself starting tasks without thinking about how long they’ll take or how to plan them out?
I’m not really sure. I suppose time can get away from me sometimes, but I don’t think I plan it out very carefully. I just start doing something and… well, I don’t always think it through first.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through, like saying or doing something without considering the consequences?

Yes… I suppose I do. Mostly in meetings, like committee meetings. Someone will still be talking and a thought pops into my head, and I just say it before I lose it. I don’t mean to interrupt, but… it happens.
Do you often find it hard to focus or stay on task, even when you’re trying your best to pay attention?

Yes… I think so. Like if I sit down with the senior center newsletter, or the choir schedule, I start out reading it, but after a few minutes I realize I’ve gone over the same lines and I don’t really know what I just read.
Do these feelings of restlessness and trouble staying focused happen in different parts of your life, like at home, at work, or in social situations?

Yes… it does, I think. It’s not just at home. My family’s had to help with bills and paperwork, and at church or in the garden group, people have had to redo plans or cover things I forgot or let drop. I don’t like saying that. It’s embarrassing… like they can’t really count on me anymore.
When did you first start noticing these feelings of restlessness and trouble focusing? Were they something you experienced even as a child or teenager?

I think it goes back pretty far… yes. Even in grade school, teachers would write things like I was bright but careless. Losing papers, talking when I shouldn’t… needing reminders to stay in my seat or finish my work. I didn’t think much of it then, but it was there.
